name: s3Download
syntax: s3Download(bucket, object [, target, charset, accessKeyId, secretKey, host])
description: Downloads an object from an S3 (or S3-compatible) bucket. When a target path is supplied, the bytes are written to that local file and true is returned; otherwise the body is returned as a UTF-8 string.

params.name: bucket
params.description: The name of the S3 bucket to download from.

params.name: target
params.description: Optional local file path to write the object bytes to. When omitted, the body is returned as a string instead.

params.name: charset
params.description: Character encoding to use when decoding the body (informational; bodies are decoded as UTF-8).

params.name: accessKeyId
params.description: Inline AWS access key id. Overrides credentials from Application.cfc and environment variables.

params.name: host
params.description: Inline endpoint URL for S3-compatible providers (e.g. Cloudflare R2, MinIO).

examples.title: Download an object to a local file
examples.description: Writes the object body to disk and returns true on success.

examples.title: Download an object into a string
examples.description: Without a target path, the body is returned directly.
